# A book kept in Hong Kong dollars that also holds US and Canadian dollars,
# with no `company` block.
#
# Every top-level account is held in HKD, so the book is kept in HKD (Q-042)
# and its reports are in HKD. Beneath them, accounts hold HKD, USD and CAD, and
# the book's price database prices USD and CAD in HKD, so GnuCash's reports
# have to convert the USD and the CAD into HKD.
#
# What this fixture produces, as of 2026-03-31:
#
# - Assets:HKD Bank 14,800.00 HKD: 10,000.00 opened on 01-02, 5,000.00 of
#   consulting on 02-10, less 200.00 of fees on 03-05.
# - Assets:USD Bank 1,500.00 USD: 1,000.00 opened on 01-02, and 500.00 of
#   consulting on 02-20.
# - Assets:CAD Bank 1,900.00 CAD: 2,000.00 opened on 01-02, less 100.00 of
#   fees on 03-10.
# - Prices at 12:00 UTC on 03-31: USD in HKD 7.80, CAD in HKD 5.70.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_statements_are_printed_by_customized_gnucash_reports.py and
# tests/integration/test_the_currency_a_book_is_kept_in.py.
2026-01-01 commodity HKD
	mnemonic: "HKD"
	fullname: "Hong Kong Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"

	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"

	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	placeholder: #True

	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Consulting
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
2026-01-01 open Income:US Consulting
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

	type: "Expense"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "HKD"
	time: "2026-03-31 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "78/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "HKD"
	time: "2026-03-31 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "57/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-02 * "Opening HKD"

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"

	Assets:CAD Bank -100.00 CAD
